changelog.text: No more asking - and pets play too. Climbing is a setting now: Social > Climbing > Who can climb on me (nobody, your partner, friends or everyone). Pets can be set to Play around me, and pets on Follow come and play when you stand still: hopping round you, bouncing, nuzzling up, then sitting beside you.

Climb on anyone (who says yes). You don't need to be friends or partners any more: look at someone with Lmg and climb - they get a little card asking, and press Y (yes for 2 hours), U (always) or N (no). See who can climb on you, clear it, or stop people asking, in Social > Climbing.

Partners, closer. If your partner says yes (Social > Partner > Let my partner climb on me), you can sit on their head or their shoulder. Stand still next to them for a bit and you start playing around them: hopping round, pulling their arm, poking them, then sitting down together. Other Lmg players see it too.

Delete means delete. Menu > Help > Delete all my Lmg data wipes everything our server has about you: friends, invites, your UID, shared pets and cosmetics, and the config codes you shared. On the website, your profile page has Delete my account, which removes your login, profile and every post.

Easier, and more of everything. Search every setting (or just start typing), a gear for more options, starting looks (Clean, Showcase, PvP, Cosy), profiles you swap with a key, and one-click low-end mode. New: PvP stats (CPS, combo, reach), an armour panel, hit sounds, hotbar styles, coloured inventories, name tag styles, damage number styles, four new skies, autumn leaves, ground mist, film grain and lens effects. Photo mode gets a self-timer, poses, a grid, ready-made looks and depth of field. Invite friends to your server, and give them nicknames.

Your sword, your crosshair. Move, turn and resize what you hold and watch it change as you drag (try Big & low). Draw your own crosshair pixel by pixel, use the Lmg star, and make it spin. The tour now asks first, with a clear No thanks.
